message: FORGE-BOUNDARY-1.3 says tree copies preserve source symlinks, but the binding path-boundary lesson says keep copytree symlinks=False because symlinks=True recreates outward source links as escapes; the required copy semantics need orchestration guidance before implementation.

notes: Follow the copy2/copytree boundary lesson, not the decomposition's old 'preserve source symlinks' wording (now amended). Use copytree's DEREFERENCING default (symlinks=False): it materializes the trusted source content into the boundary-checked destination. symlinks=True would recreate an outward source link verbatim as an escape — the exact bug fixed in FORGE-BOUNDARY-1.2. Preflight-enumerate with os.walk(followlinks=True) to MATCH copytree and validate every written destination before the first mutation (clean abort). File-copy destinations use assert_target_file_destination (rejects a crafted directory copy2 treats as a container, and a symlink it follows); dir destinations and copytree roots use assert_target_destination. Hard-link and TOCTOU classes are deferred (out of 0028's symlink scope) — do NOT try to defend them. Mirror exactly what init (scaffold.py) now does.
